title: Restore AUP4 files in the Windows Save As dialog
problem: Audacity constructs one save-dialog name filter with two parenthesized wildcard groups, which Windows does not interpret as a valid *.aup4 filter and existing projects disappear from Save As.
reproduce: Open Save As on Windows in a directory containing .aup4 projects; the malformed baseline filter does not list them.
acceptance: The project save filter contains one description and one parenthesized *.aup4 pattern group, and the shared helper test executes successfully.
repair: Generate the project filter as Audacity 4 files (*.aup4) and cover the exact grammar in the project path utility tests.

selection.reason: The current filter grammar is invalid, the Windows acceptance is precise, and the exact pinned submodule revisions were verified.

verification.limitations: BCL compiles and runs the production filter helper and verifies its use in the save scenario. A Windows owner or upstream CI should confirm native-dialog listing.
verification.ownerCheck: On Windows, open Save As in a directory containing .aup4 files and confirm they are visible under the Audacity 4 files filter.
